subfamily: savoury highball (built on DeGroff's Bullshot, Oxford BULLSHOT pdf 375), shaken and strained over ice
glass: tall highball glass (about 400 ml), filled with ice
version: v1 (Tomás, round 2, 2026-10-04). Built on DeGroff's printed Bullshot (Oxford BULLSHOT pdf 375: 45 ml vodka, 100 ml beef broth canned or house-made, 5 ml fresh orange juice, 5 ml medium dry sherry, 2 dashes Tabasco, pinch of black pepper; shaken, strained over ice, orange peel twisted over). Kept: vodka, broth, both orange touches (5 ml juice, peel), the sherry, shake and strain over ice. Changed (mine, so never 'his recipe'): Tabasco and pepper out (spice); house-made unsalted broth, which his recipe allows, not canned (canned row is gluten/egg-white/dairy, safe side); a small pinch of salt back in (Oxford pdf 374: at Charlie O's they left the salt out because canned broth was so salty); vodka 45->60 and broth 100->90 (his proportions read 8.7% after the shake, under the highball floor). Freeform (Arnold has no savoury style). As shaken (style shaken for the dilution formula): 160 ml -> 43.6% -> ~230 ml, 10.8% ABV, 0.44 g sugar/100 ml, 0.028% acid; judged by hand on highball ranges (10-16 / 0-7 / 0-0.6): in range. Melt in the glass not modelled. Sweeps: vodka 37.5/50% -> 10.3/13.0%; sherry sugar 0.2-5 g -> 0.39-0.50 g; broth sugar 1 g -> 0.72 g; broth 80/100 ml -> 11.4/10.3%.
